description:
Activate Omen Hawker by tapping it, adding {C}{U} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Meloku by paying {1} and returning a land from the battlefield to your hand, creating a 1/1 Illusion creature token.
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting up to two land cards from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land(s) enter, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers that many times, untapping Omen Hawker.
Repeat.
